title: pub items used only inside their own file
body:
Items marked `pub` with no use outside their own file: `TOP` and `sidebar_width` in `frame.rs`; `Row` in `menu.rs`; `Side`, `inner` and `arrange` in `panes.rs`; `Knob` in `settings.rs`; `ANOTHER_SERVER` in `control.rs`; `round_trip` and `TextTexture` in `draw.rs`; `Server` in `mcp.rs`, which exists only so the caller can read `.url`; `FONT_FAMILY` in `text.rs`; `ViewerOffer` and `State` in `compositor.rs`; `Saved` in `save.rs`; `MAX_MESSAGE_LEN` and `MAX_FDS_PER_SEND` in `wire.rs`; `VERSION`, `Hello`, `Focus`, `Client` and the fields of `Router` in `channel.rs`. `Decoder::push_bytes` and `push_fd` are used only by tests.

Forwarders with one caller: `pane_under_pointer` to `pane_at`, `Frame::name` to `fit`, `State::pane_area` to `frame::pane_area`.

`unique_name` and `unique_pane_name` in `workspace.rs` are the same first-free-count loop with a different separator.

## Proposal

Make the items private, have `mcp::start` return `io::Result<String>`, inline the forwarders, and give the two unique-name loops one function that takes the separator.
